company_profile: sennder is a European digital freight forwarder running road logistics on one platform that connects shippers with carriers.
title: Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Senior Machine Learning Engineer with 8+ years across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, owning models end to end from prototype to production. Combines statistical modelling and classical ML for prediction, forecasting, recommendation re-ranking and anomaly detection with LLM applications and AI agents, choosing the right approach for each problem. Works in Python, SQL and PySpark, deploys with FastAPI, Docker and MLflow, and builds dashboards and prototypes with product and business stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Freight Price Estimation Model
bullets: Built a price estimation and capacity forecasting model for road freight lanes, combining LightGBM regression on lane, distance and seasonality features with Holt-Winters baselines.
Validated it with backtesting and hypothesis tests against rule-based pricing, served estimates through FastAPI with MLflow tracking, and shared results in a Streamlit dashboard.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Machine Learning Engineer role on your ML team. Most of my work sits between data science and engineering: exploring the data until the problem is clear, building the model, then taking it into production myself. That end-to-end habit is the thread through my 8+ years in Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps.

What draws me to sennder is that it owns the platform, the operations and the data behind road freight, so a pricing or carrier forecasting model meets real outcomes quickly. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Amsterdam together and settle there long term.

I would bring models that people actually use. At Viavi I built an SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow that cut downtime by 67%, and at Optum I added a reranker to a live recommendation system that lifted conversion by 2%. I also build LLM agents, so I know when an LLM helps and when a simple model wins.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Working with those teachers taught me to start from the user's workflow before writing any code. I would be glad to talk about how I could help your team.
